title: EduQuest
tagline: Gasless transaction learn and earn 📘 Course-based  and proof-of-learning certificates
description:
Yellow Learn & Earn is a decentralized education platform where users learn Web3 concepts, complete interactive lessons and quizzes, and earn on-chain rewards for their progress.Gasless transaction learn and earn Architecture:

Frontend: Built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS for a fast, interactive UI.

Backend: Uses MongoDB for course data, chapters, quizzes, and tracking user progress and reward history.

Real-Time Engine: Socket-based system for challenges and quiz battles between users.

Smart Contracts: Handle course funding, reward allocation, and on-chain proof of completion using Solidity and Viem/Wagmi.
